body.name: \mathcal L_P(c,\vartheta)
body.construction: For \(c\in[1/4,3/4]\) and \(\vartheta\in\Theta\), define the four-cell Bernoulli-pair profile loss by \[\mathcal L_P(c,\vartheta)=\inf_{q\in\mathcal Q(c,\vartheta)}\int_0^1\sum_{d,y\in\{0,1\}}p_{d,y,P}(x)\log\frac{p_{d,y,P}(x)}{q_{d,y}(x)}\,dx.\] Use \(0\log(0/q)=0\), and set a summand to \(+\infty\) when \(p_{d,y,P}(x)>0=q_{d,y}(x)\). The optimization domain in \(\text{def:population-profile-domain}\) includes singular boundary cells. The reference split is the feasible pair \((c_P,\theta_P)\), for which \(\mathcal L_P(c_P,\theta_P)=0\).
